observations: Apple SDK declares device and stream latency in frames and sums those two hardware contributions; safety offset and buffer are separate properties. AudioUnit latency is a separate seconds-valued property.
The current pinned CPAL callback timestamp only adds buffer duration.

inference: Read all declared components separately through the existing Core Audio boundary; do not blindly sum AudioUnit and device values.
Uniform stream latency permits a common declared hardware path across current output streams; refuse nonuniform streams instead of assuming a channel mapping.
